profile.headline: Scrum Lead, LMTS at Salesforce
profile.summary: I've worked with computers in various ways since I was 6 and quickly found a love for their logic. I later became interested more in web based solutions. Now I work to deliver cloud platforms that matter to customers!

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description: Taking on more responsibility and a leadership role, I've joined with a startup to develop an integrated solution for local and national organizations. We help Not-For-Profits, For-Profits, and Sales organizations to join in raising funds to help organization grow. During my time I've had the benefit of working with remote contractors, small and large payment systems, social media API's, and development of systems both on the WordPress Platform and privately developed applications.
